estimand: Production toolchain performance under common functional output requirements; not isolated bundler-core or language causality

jsSourceMaps.required: external for every emitted JS file

cssSourceMaps: record availability; not required for primary build endpoint
assets: external image files; no inline threshold optimization
chunking: preserve dynamic imports; automatic tool partitioning; no hand-selected vendor groups or chunk-size tuning
applicationDependencies: exact common direct versions within each application; lockfiles and full transitive inventories archived
hosts: same host within a measured block; separate cross-host replication
timing: external npm run build elapsed time, caches cleared, OS cache uncontrolled
